digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and packaged guides
propositions: Author-facing guide must explain naming risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) and committing to concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codification.

The guide must identify the de-risk guidance as T15 criterion, state that proof is either local run or manual probe against real target, and describe teardown scoped only to resources created by throwaway experiments.
Packaged guide criterion-pins.json must be regenerated with the new T15 pin and remain stack-agnostic without product-specific Terraform or Docker instructions.
Hand-authored docs/plan-review-gate.md must update enumeration from T1–T12 to T1–T15 and align stated criterion count to validated registry cardinality.
Registry module docstring in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py must reflect validated 44 / T1–T15 vocabulary to maintain authority alignment with author-facing docs.
